```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 7,
                      fig.height = 4, dpi = 120, fig.align = "center")
```

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(phylloptim)
```

`vignette("phylloptim")` shows the model running. `vignette("fitting")` fits it to data. This page is the reference for *what is being solved*: the objective, the cost curves that distinguish one published model from another, the first-order conditions, and the two optional blocks that change them.

Most numbers quoted in the prose here are produced by the code chunk beside them. That is deliberate. A formula sitting next to code it no longer matches is the failure this document is most exposed to.

Some numbers cannot be generated that way. Timings, cross-platform magnitudes, and the fitted vulnerability curves in Appendix A all come from elsewhere: the benchmark harness, CI, the literature. Nothing re-checks those when this page is rendered, so treat them as reported measurements rather than as live output.

Several counts below are quoted against the **reference grid**, which is worth naming once. It is a fixed set of 576 driver combinations — 6 soil potentials, 4 light levels, 4 vapour pressure deficits and 3 soil-layer counts, at two leaf temperatures — that the package solves and stores as a regression baseline. When a passage says "42 of 240 feasible rows", those are rows of that grid.

## How to read this page

| If you want | Read |
